opening.argument: The offer ties upfront payments directly to promised mining returns: viewers are told to pay a $99 membership fee and spend five hundred dollars on a share that pays for 1000 days of mining. It also adds referral commissions for bringing in new members, combining paid participation and recruitment with the prospect of returns. These claims support the position that this is a paid mining and returns scheme. The available evidence does not establish whether the mining operations or payouts existed.
